title: Top 5 Upcoming Events in South Florida
igCaption:
Five big dates for your calendar: III Points (Oct 16–17), the Fort Lauderdale Boat Show (Oct 28–Nov 1), NASCAR Championship Weekend (Nov 6–8), Beach Polo World Cup (Nov 12–15) and Art Basel Miami Beach (Dec 4–6).

Which one are you going to?

Sources: III Points, Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show, NASCAR, World Polo League, Art Basel

#miamievents #artbasel #miami #southflorida

scenes.text: These are the five biggest things happening in South Florida that you probably don't want to miss.

Number five: the Beach Polo World Cup, November twelfth through fifteenth. Eight international teams and more than one hundred twenty horses play on the sand behind the Setai, between Twenty-first and Twenty-second Street in South Beach.
scenes.caption: #5: the Beach Polo World Cup, November 12–15. Eight international teams and more than 120 horses play on the sand behind the Setai, between 21st and 22nd Street in South Beach.

location.name: Beach behind The Setai, Miami Beach

scenes.text: Number four: NASCAR Championship Weekend at Homestead-Miami Speedway, November sixth through eighth, where the season titles get decided across multiple series.
scenes.caption: #4: NASCAR Championship Weekend at Homestead-Miami Speedway, November 6–8, where the season titles get decided across multiple series.

scenes.text: Number three: III Points at Mana Wynwood, October sixteenth and seventeenth. More than one hundred fifty artists on ten stages, including Underworld, Four Tet and Charlotte de Witte.
scenes.caption: #3: III Points at Mana Wynwood, October 16 and 17. More than 150 artists on 10 stages, including Underworld, Four Tet and Charlotte de Witte.

scenes.text: Number two: the Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show, October twenty-eighth to November first. It's the largest in-water boat show in the world, with more than thirteen hundred boats across seven locations and over one hundred thousand people.
scenes.caption: #2: the Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show, October 28 to November 1. It's the largest in-water boat show in the world, with more than 1,300 boats across seven locations and over 100,000 people.

scenes.text: And number one: Art Basel Miami Beach, open to the public December fourth through sixth at the Miami Beach Convention Center. More than two hundred eighty galleries from over forty countries.
scenes.caption: And #1: Art Basel Miami Beach, open to the public December 4–6 at the Miami Beach Convention Center. More than 280 galleries from over 40 countries.
